description: This file is a PHP script responsible for handling the saving of an Account record in the SuiteCRM application. It performs a save operation via an AccountFormBase object and manages the request parameters involved in duplication checks.

classes.name: AccountFormBase
classes.description: A form handler class for Account records, responsible for creating, editing, and saving Account data.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the Account record, with parameters controlling duplication handling and whether to redirect or not.
